newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-PARIS ST GERMAIN 3 LIVERPOOL 0 - RESULT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PARIS ST GERMAIN 3 LIVERPOOL 0 - RESULT.

text.p: Paris St Germain of France beat England's Liverpool 3-0 (halftime 2-0) in the first leg of their European Cup Winners' Cup semifinal on Thursday.
Scorers: Leonardo 10, Benoit Cauet 42, Jerome Leroy 83

Paris - 1-Bernard Lama; 13-Laurent Fournier, 4-Bruno N'Gotty, 6-Paul Le Guen, 19-Jerome Leroy (12-Bernard Allou 84); 15-Benoit Cauet, 8-Vincent Guerin, 7-Leonardo, 22-Didier Domi (17-Jimmy Algerino 32), 10-Rai, 11-Patrice Loko (26-Cyrille Pouget 81).

Liverpool - 1-David James; 21-Dominic Matteo, 4-Jason McAteer, 5-Mark Wright, 20-Stig Bjornebye; 12-Steve Harkness, 7-Steve McManaman, 8-Stan Collymore (16-Michael Thomas 46) 10-John Barnes, 9-Robbie Fowler, 11-Jamie Redknapp.
